policy: Go slowly. Weekly runs are deltas wherever the source allows it; full refreshes are spaced out. Detail-page backfills stay off until a few weeks of runs show how the sources respond. A run that hits a firewall rejection stops at once and skips detail pages the next week.

fetches: WellSTAR Notices layer: every permit (paged ArcGIS query, about 5 requests)
WellSTAR Wells layer: every well, keeps the ones permits reference (about 120 requests)
sources.notes: ArcGIS map service built for paged queries. Unchanged: full every week.

fetches: Approved Form 2 list, last 12 months (2 requests: page and postback)
sources.notes: 4 requests a week, all published files. No detail pages or scout cards are fetched.

fetches: APD map layers with each key's status code (2 requests)

APD report only for keys that are new or whose status code changed: a handful of requests most weeks. The first run has no saved codes, so it reads new keys plus active permits and a quarter of the pending queue (about 6 requests)
Statewide well map layer for well status codes (1 request, about 24 MB)
Well report only for new or changed wells (all about 1,500 matched wells on the first run: about 4 requests)
Up to 15 APD detail pages for newly approved APDs
Full (every 28 days): the APD and well reports for every key, and up to 30 detail pages (about 60 requests)
sources.notes: The Data Explorer firewall blocked this site on 2026-11-07 after about 1,600 detail pages in two hours. Saved status codes: data/wy/source_codes.jsonl.
